note: The Atlas engine is built from the public Enntity/atlas fork at this exact commit; build.sh refuses any other tree.

upstream_candidate.note: upstream/glm53-flash at 0b515eec (the RC4 engine commits plus four CI-only fixes) plus the GLM tool-value fix ade7b012 (tool calls longer than 1024 tokens were cut: the envelope-stuck guard knew only Qwen's parameter markers) plus d8a55e0f: when the same tool calls return the same non-error result twice or more, the latest tool result gets a <REPEAT NOTICE> and that turn the xhigh thinking rung (unless the client set a budget), and <tool_call> stays open and unbiased; the loop detector no longer hard-masks <tool_call>, which had left GLM narrating its intended action as prose.

sparkglm_only.note: The seven SparkGLM-only commits re-layered on the upstream candidate (26812d35..dfb9c26a): FlashKDA/native sparse-MLA prefill bridges (the first, 26812d35, declares the KV-shard flag its native bridge reads, which upstream dropped as unused), GB10 display-carveout KV placement (latent pools only, ATLAS_KV_CARVEOUT_ORDER), and sharded latent pools (ATLAS_GLM_KV_SHARD, opt-in through SPARKGLM_KV_SHARD) sized and placed in the carveout. Fork-only; the carveout is used only with DISPLAY_CARVEOUT=1.

integration.note: RC4 (tree ae5e79f8, the measured exp/prose-rc4 c6089633). This pin differs from it by two spark-server changes (the tool-value fix and the repeat notice) and four CI-only upstream commits; the decode path is unchanged. RC4.1 was sparkglm/atlas-20261012-rc4.1-layered 301479a2.
